row.team_price_text: Pro: $25/month, or $250/year ($21/month) billed annually, for 100 credits; flat per workspace, unlimited users
row.evidence: Lovable's pricing page lists 'Directory sync (SCIM)' under Enterprise ('Volume based pricing', 'Book a demo'), and the SCIM docs say 'It is available on the Enterprise plan.'
row.notes: New in 2026-09. Plans are flat per workspace and priced by credits, not per user (unlimited users on every plan): Pro from $25/mo ($21/mo billed annually), Business from $50/mo ($42/mo annually), Enterprise volume-based. SSO (OIDC or SAML) starts at Business; SCIM and audit logs need Enterprise, and SCIM also needs an active SSO provider and a verified domain. SCIM 2.0 at https://api.lovable.dev/scim/v2 with a bearer key; deprovisioning removes the member and transfers owned projects. Roles come from IdP group mappings. Okta OIN app provisions (Create/Update/Deactivate/Group Push); Entra's gallery app is OIDC SSO only and SCIM there needs a separate SAML app. The Lovable REST API (Business+) only reads members and groups. JIT on SSO login is available on Business.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Flat per workspace; higher credit tiers cost more.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.price_text: Platform fee, volume based pricing (Book a demo)
plans.notes: Audit logs included (UI + JSONL export); no audit-log API documented.

auth.token_source: Workspace settings > Access > Identity > SCIM provisioning > Enable (key shown once; rotate from the General tab)

operations.notes: Docs list Users create/read/update/delete/list and Groups create/read/update/delete/list/member push; PUT vs PATCH is not specified.

deprovision.data_retained: User is removed from the workspace (pending invites deleted). Projects they owned transfer to the highest-role member; Restricted projects are not transferred and must be moved by an owner.

roles.how: IdP group-to-role mapping (Viewer, Editor, Admin, Owner) configured in Lovable; highest-privilege mapped role wins; unmapped users get the default role (Viewer).

limitations.text: SCIM cannot deactivate or delete the workspace owner.
Microsoft Entra ID provisioning works only through a SAML enterprise app, even if SSO uses OIDC.
Only users whose email domain is verified for the workspace are provisioned.
Removing a user from all mapped groups does not remove workspace access; unassign the app in the IdP instead.

audit_log_api.notes: Audit logs (Enterprise) can be exported as JSONL from the UI; no audit-log API endpoint is documented.

rate_limits.text: Sliding-window limits per API key, reported in X-RateLimit-* headers; 429 with Retry-After when exceeded.

limitations.text: The Lovable API's member endpoints are read-only; no create, invite, update or remove member endpoints are documented.

okta.notes: OIN page marks SAML, OIDC, SCIM and Create/Update/Deactivate/Group Push as checked (read from page markup).

entra.notes: Gallery app 'Lovable (OIDC)' is SSO only; Lovable's docs say Entra SCIM needs a SAML enterprise app (generic SCIM).

onelogin.notes: Not named; Lovable documents a generic 'Other SCIM 2.0 providers' setup.

jumpcloud.notes: Not named; Lovable documents a generic 'Other SCIM 2.0 providers' setup.

fallbacks.notes: Verified-domain email sign-up can also auto-join users; members list can be exported (not imported) as CSV.

open_questions: SCIM user attributes beyond userName (email) are not documented.
PUT vs PATCH support, filtering and pagination for /scim/v2 are not documented.
Whether SCIM removal frees a seat is moot (unlimited users), and session revocation is not documented.
SCIM token expiry is not documented (keys are rotated manually).
No Google Workspace, OneLogin or JumpCloud catalogue apps were found; OneLogin/JumpCloud are via the generic setup.
No audit-log API endpoint; only UI export.
